_comment: Worker-class manifest, renders prompts/general/agent.md. General-purpose ephemeral ticket worker: an opus worker that takes ONE ARBITRARY Vikunja ticket (triggered by the eph:general label, routed LAST so narrow labels win) and works it end-to-end in a disposable worktree, then exits. Unlike the narrow classes it is broad in tools and general in tickets. Its guardrails are the auto-classifier (--permission-mode auto, no allow-list), the enforced deny floor (_GENERAL_DENIED), the shared fleet rules explicitly included in this prompt, and a cred-free, broker-only feature-branch MR publish. Thin and stable by design: this signed prompt carries ephemeral-oneshot framing, shared fleet/UI rules, scope, capability, hard floor and output envelope. It does not embed the user-level instructions file (its mode block is machine-rewritten); a harness may load it separately, but workers never assume inheritance. sections = ordered module paths (no .md); vars fill {{slots}} at build time. Content is operator-gated: the rendered prompt's sha256 must be signed into approved-prompts.json by the operator before it runs.
